newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Kansas City, Mo..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Kansas City, Mo..

text.p: Sealed proposals for the purchase of $40,000,000 principal amount of General Obligation Bonds (Streetlight Project), Series 1997B, of the City of Kansas City, Missouri (the City''), will be received by the City Treasurer, on behalf of the Director of Finance, at the office of the City Treasurer, City Hall, First Floor, 414 East 12th Street, Kansas City, Missouri 64106, until 9:00 A.M., Central Daylight Time on

The City has prepared a Notice of Bond Sale, Official Bid Form and Preliminary Official Statement, copies of which may be obtained from the City Treasurer or the City's Financial Advisors. It is anticipated the bid packages will be mailed June 30, 1997. Additional information regarding the Series 1997B Bonds and the Sale may be obtained from the City Treasurer, Randall J. Landes (816) 274-1317 or from the City's Financial Advisors: Fahnestock & Co. Inc., 4717 Grand, Kansas City, Missouri 64114, Attention: Jack Holland (816) 932-7039 or Knight Capital L.L.C., 2405 Grand, Suite 500, Kansas City, Missouri 64108, Attention: Courtney Knight (816) 374-7611.
By Janice M. Reed, Director of Finance
